# Synthetic fixture

Generated by `generate_fixture.py` with fixed seed 7319. The clean and dirty CSVs each have 10 columns; the dirty file has 31 data rows, including one exact duplicate. The manifest records deliberate blank/placeholder, invalid email/numeric/date, mixed unambiguous date formats, date-order and arithmetic inconsistencies, case/whitespace category variants, statistical outlier, ambiguous date, near-spelling candidate and duplicate cases. The synthetic outlier and near-category example are deliberately flagged without repairs. This fixture is for regression tests only and is not a general accuracy benchmark.
# Synthetic dataset fixtures

`datafix_dirty.csv` and `datafix_error_manifest.json` form the compact fast test
fixture (30 base rows plus one duplicate). Generate them with
`python tests/fixtures/generate_fixture.py` from `backend/`.

`datafix_1000_dirty.csv` and `datafix_1000_error_manifest.json` form the
1,000-row analysis benchmark (plus one exact duplicate). Generate the clean and
dirty variants with `python tests/fixtures/generate_scale_fixture.py` from
`backend/`. All email addresses use the reserved `.test` domain and values are
synthetic.
